summary_1line: Bhima defeats and dismounts Karna while Duryodhana urges Drona to protect Jayadratha, framing the battle as a deadly gamble centered on Jayadratha.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima cuts Karna’s bowstring and slays his charioteer and horses as Karna, bleeding and furious, leaps onto Vrishasena’s chariot.
Bhima stands roaring like thunder on the battlefield while conchs sound and Krishna blows Panchajanya beside Arjuna.
Drona tells Duryodhana that the battle is a game of dice where arrows are the dice and Jayadratha is the stake.
